transcript: 5 gentle techniques that may help regulate your nervous system when nothing else seems to work. Most things do not work for stress because they try to fix the mind, when the body is the one asking for safety. 1. Stop forcing calm. In my years, I have seen that the body does not soften under demand. When you try to relax, tension often increases. When pressure is removed, rest begins to appear on its own. 2. Lengthen the exhale. Gently, do not pull the breath. Allow the exhale to become slightly longer than the inhale. The body understands this as a sign of safety and begins to settle without effort. 3. Add touch, not thought. Place one hand on the chest or the belly. Feel warmth. Feel movement. The body listens to sensation long before it listens to ideas. 4. Allow rest without sleep. Do not chase sleep. Lie down and allow the body to be heavy. When effort leaves, sleep often arrives quietly. 5. Repeat small signals of safety. Not once, not perfectly, but gently, every day. The nervous system learns through repetition, not force. If stress lives in your body and nothing has worked, the way back to stillness is in the link in my bio. Not to fix you, but to help your body remember what it already knows. How to feel safe.
